blurb: Crown Point Country Club offers a championship 18-hole golf course with five tee options, a driving range, and practice putting green. The club provides golf carts, locker rooms, and the GHIN system. The Crown Point Pub offers food and a full bar with views over the course, and a banquet room is available for events.
extraNote: Alcohol must be purchased from CPCC; outside alcohol will be confiscated · No alcohol sold or served to persons under 21; staff may refuse service to intoxicated individuals
